### Carried and paid

- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE FOURTH OF JANUARY ARRIVED AND NOTHING HAPPENED, AND THE CHAPTER IS THE NOTHING.** **No court in this harbor sat, no clerk came up that hill, nobody was charged with anything, nobody was fined, nobody was refused anything, nobody was examined, and nobody in this town did anything about it except two people in a shed who had a thing in a drawer and left it there.** The reason is the reason of the seventh of December past and is that a thing done in order to be ready is a thing that arrives with a date on it, and it was said out loud in a shed once, with the hour on it. **And the half of the reason that is in the shed and not in a market: the copy could be produced tomorrow, and a letter would be up that road in four days and in a man's hand in nine and in a court in ten, and nothing whatever would happen to anybody, and in about four years a clerk in that court would have a piece of paper with this yard's name at the head of it and a date on it.** **A PARTY WHICH DOES NOT PRODUCE A COPY IS NOT FINED, THE COURT FINDS AGAINST NOBODY, A PERSON WHO IS NOT EXAMINED IS NOT A PERSON WHO HAS BEEN REFUSED, AND NONE OF THOSE SENTENCES WAS RESTATED, IMPROVED ON, OR USED IN ANY ARGUMENT IN THIS BATCH. THIS PARTY ASKED NO OFFICE FOR ANYTHING, SENT NOTHING TO A CITY, DID NOT WRITE TO A MAN IN A COAT, AND HAS NOT BEEN TO THE COUNTER OF THAT CIRCUIT OFFICE SINCE THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF NOVEMBER 2026, AND NONE OF THAT CHANGED.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE ELEVEN-LINE LIST'S ITEM ELEVEN, WHICH IS NOW A THING THIS YARD HAS SAID OUT LOUD IT CANNOT PUT IN FRONT OF ANYBODY.** Said in the yard's own book on Thursday the thirtieth of December past. **Its second instance is the refusal of a man's own figure at the head of that dock on Wednesday the sixth of January, and the refusal was a refusal and not a request, and the figure is not in this yard's book and will not be asked for.** **The line is not off the list and is not going to be.** The coast road is in type in a city beside a pilot's figure, neither withdrawn, not resolved and not called anything, the Kettle not looked at, the refused licence unreversed and the thirty marks not paid, not owed to anybody and applicable to nothing, **and the word *network* is in no mouth in this batch.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE BOY IN A JUNE BERTH, AND THE FACT THAT NOBODY WENT.** **No day of this chapter is a scene in the berth. The yard does not go, does not write, does not send anybody, does not ask anybody who has seen him what he said, and enters the fact that it did not go and the reason, which is the reason of the fourth of October past and is not a new one and was not invented again.** The three nots stand and forty marks stands whole. **THE COST FELL ON A BOAT OF ABOUT FORTY TONS OF THE THIRD LAY THAT HAS BEEN ONE HAND SHORT SINCE THE MIDDLE OF JULY, AND OUT OF ONE PART OWNER'S SHARE SINCE THEN, BEING FOUR MARKS, ONE SHILLING AND EIGHTPENCE, and it is not coming back and nobody is going to ask this yard for it. IT IS NOT THE THIRD LAY'S FOUR DAYS, NOT A MAN OF THE FIRST LAY'S MONDAY, NOT THE TIDE GANG'S THURSDAY MORNING AND NOT A HIRED MAN'S DAY ON A LIGHTER, AND ITS SHAPE IS A MAN WHO CAME OFF THE STONE AND WAS NOT REPLACED.** **And four men in that crew have not gone to see him either, and one of them said so to the shipwright's hand in a street and said he was one of the four.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE THIRD COST OF MOVEMENT 1 WALKED INTO THE BATCH'S OWN TURN, AND IT WAS NOT OUT OF NOTHING.** **Two men of the first lay said a thing about this yard at the head of that dock on a third day inside five weeks, the seventeenth and nineteenth of December past and now Saturday the ninth of January, one of them saying that a dry room was turned down in this town in this weather and the other that they will have somewhere and that a man does not turn down a man's key unless he has a better one. NEITHER MAN IS NAMED, THIS PARTY HAS NOT GOT EITHER NAME, NOBODY HAS ASKED EITHER OF THEM ANYTHING, AND THIS YARD WENT UP ON NONE OF THE THREE DAYS. THE THIRD OF THE THREE IS NOT OUT OF NOTHING AND THE ENTRY SAYS WHY: a man asked a question in front of about eleven people and this yard said no in front of about eleven people and the two of them were standing there.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE PRICE OF A CHECKABLE PAGE AND OF AN UNCHECKABLE ONE, PRICED AGAIN, IN ANOTHER TRADE, ON A DIFFERENT QUESTION.** **A copyist of fifty-eight priced a thing on the water in her own trade's words and the price is not a figure: a yard of one and a half with about three marks in it cannot build anything; a thing on the water is not a building, a building is made once and a thing on the water is a bill, and it is a bill every time anybody looks at it, and nobody can produce the number of times anybody is going to look at it, and a man who gives you that number has made it up; and a man has got to know when it was last looked at, by whom and what it was found to be, and all three of those go in a book, and a book costs nothing to keep, and that is exactly why it is not worth anything. AND IN THIRTY-ONE YEARS NO MAN WHO CAME TO THAT COUNTER WITH A LIST HAS EVER ASKED HER WHAT IT WILL COST TO BE THE THING AFTERWARDS.** **She was not told what a second column is, she did not ask, and no money of this yard went into that room on any day of this batch.** A second-column fact with a reason against it and no name in it.
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE HOSE, AND NO FIGURE ON IT.** **The compressor was looked at for the first time since the twentieth of October, and the answer to what useless means is that the part is on the machine and it holds and there is no hose, and the yard declined to price a foot of it and gave the reason, that the answer is not a figure and a compressor in a harbor with no hose is a thing that makes noise.** **AND THE CONSEQUENCE ON THE PAGE, WHICH IS THE BATCH'S WORKING RULE: a day at a seam in this harbor is a day with somebody else's pump on it, and the three marks is for the hands and the line and the tide, and not one penny of it is for a machine.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE TURN, IN THE YARD'S OWN HAND, IN THE FIRST COLUMN, WITH THE DATE AND THE HOUR ON IT.** **A party which has refused to hold a copy of a record for the coast, and has said so in the open in about eleven people's hearing, is read as a party which means to keep it; and the only way to be read correctly is to have somewhere to put it that is not a hold; and this yard has not got one, and knows what one would cost, and is not going to pretend it knows the cost of a thing it has not built.** **IT IS IN THE FIRST COLUMN AND NOT THE SECOND BECAUSE IT IS CHECKABLE BY ANY MAN WHO CAN GET OFF A MOLE: he can come up that hill and ask the two of them whether they have got a place to put a page in and be told they have not, and can go down to a chandler's on the north side and ask a man of sixty-eight whether he has offered it and been told that he has.** A question is left standing that this party is not answering in a market, in a room, or in this book.
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE COST, READ OUT IN ONE BREATH IN CHAPTER 220, AND EVERY ITEM IN IT IS A FIGURE ON THE PAGE:** a day of about three marks refused by this yard on the twenty-fifth of December past; a day of about three marks offered on the first of January instant and not taken; four marks, one shilling and eightpence out of a man's share; this yard's own method said out loud in a street; a name off a list in a book in another town; about six marks a man of thirty-one will not get back; **and a corner of a sheet and a half gone soft on a bench about the width of two fingers, on a sheet that came up that hill on foot on the ninth of December and is worth a penny and cannot be bought and is not lifted off the bench, because there is nowhere in this harbor to lift it on to.**

### Opened or advanced by this batch

- **NEW, AND PAID — NINETEEN LINES IN A SHIPWRIGHT'S HAND, WHICH IS A LIST AND NOT A PLAN.** **A list of what a thing that has to float and be found in this harbor is made of, in a shipwright's words, and every item on it is a figure this yard cannot pay or gear it does not own, and the seventh is a hand, and a hand is a person, and this yard has not got a person. THE DAY'S COST WAS ENTERED AGAINST THAT DAY BEFORE THE DAY WAS SPENT. NO BUOY WENT INTO ANY WATER, NO STAGE WAS TAKEN, THE BOOK OF HOURS STANDS AT SIXTEEN LINES, AND THE ONLY OTHER NAME THIS YARD HAS IS NOT ON THE LIST. A PLAN IS WHAT YOU DO WHEN SOMEBODY IS GOING TO PAY FOR IT.**
- **NEW, AND PAID — A DRY ROOM WITH A FIREBOX, A LOCK AND A SHELF, ABOVE A CHANDLER'S ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THIS TOWN, KEPT SINCE A MAN OF THIRTY-ONE WAS ITS KEEPER, WHO IS NOW SIXTY-EIGHT, AND WHO IS GOING OUT OF IT IN THE SPRING.** The best thing anybody in this harbor could offer this party in three weeks, offered in good faith and for nothing, and refused in the open with the reason given in the open. **THE CROWN'S POSITION IS NOT REFUTED BY IT AND IS NOT NEEDED: the man himself said that he has a dry room, and the holder said the reason is the same whichever word you use, and that is the whole of it.** The man has not been asked again and is not going to be. **THE ROOM GOES TO A MAN WHO BUYS CHANDLERS IN THE SPRING AND WILL NOT KNOW WHAT THE PAPER IS, AND THAT IS WHY THE OFFER WAS GOOD AND WHY IT COULD NOT BE TAKEN.**
- **NEW, AND PAID — THREE SENTENCES A MAN CAN SAY IN A STREET, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS WRONG.** **If he says this yard has nowhere to put it, he is telling about eleven people that this yard means to keep it. If he says this yard has somewhere to put it, that is a lie. If he says this yard will give it up, that is a lie of the other kind and is the one that hurts.** And the reason the difficulty is not the first of those is that **the only way to be read correctly is to have somewhere to put it that is not a hold, and this yard has not got one.** **The gap between the two columns of that chapter is not closed and the chapter says on the page that it is not closed and that the answer is a hole and a hole in a street fills itself.**
- **NEW, AND PAID — THIS YARD'S OWN METHOD, SAID OUT LOUD IN A STREET IN ABOUT NINE PEOPLE'S HEARING, FOR THE FIRST TIME IN FOUR VOLUMES.** What went out loud was the method and not a figure: that a list of what does not go into a room is the instrument this yard has and that no line of it comes off. **A method nobody can say is a method two people can check. Whether that is a good trade is not checkable from a mole and the four people of this coast are the only people in this harbor who could say, and they have not been asked and are not going to be.**
- **NEW, AND PAID — A NAME OFF A LIST IN A BOOK IN THE NEXT TOWN DOWN THIS COAST, WRITTEN OFF WITH A PEN IN ABOUT FOUR SECONDS BY A WOMAN IN AN OFFICE.** **A man is not asked at that place again, and that is not a day and it is not a wage and it cannot be put back by anybody. A column nobody fills is a column somebody else fills, and this batch showed what that looks like: it looks like a woman with a pen who did not know what she was writing off and could not be asked about it.** The name is in a speaker's mouth and **is not in this yard's book**, and the reason is entered against the line.
- **NEW, AND PAID — THE FIGURE THE BAG IS SHORT OF THE WAGE WENT THE WRONG WAY TWICE.** Five hundred and fifty-six pence on the morning of the twenty-ninth of December past, three marks came in that morning, one thousand and thirty-six pence that afternoon, and one thousand nine hundred and ninety-six pence on the twelfth of January. **A figure any man can get off a mole can check that, and it is the first time in this book that a day's work and a wage's shortfall have moved in opposite directions on the same page.**
- **NEW, AND PAID — A REASON FOR THE WAGE, ENTERED ONCE.** That a wage is a week and not a payment; that paying one week out of ten leaves a bag that pays one week and no other; that a man paid a week in the last week of December and nothing in the second week of January has been given a figure and not a wage; that a column with the fifth of March still the oldest and the twenty-ninth of December newest is a column nine weeks out of order, and this yard is not going to begin it. **It may not be improved on, shortened, or said a second way.**
- **NEW, AND PAID — A DAY OFFERED AND NOT TAKEN, AND THE BODY, WITH NO NAME IN IT.** A day of about three marks was offered on Friday the first of January instant and could not be taken, the figure is entered against that day and against no day at all, and the reason is in the second column and is not checkable from a mole and is not going to have one. **The man of the second lay was not told a figure had been put against it.**

### Carried and paid

- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE BARE FACT OF THE NINE, READ OUT OF THIS YARD'S OWN SECOND COLUMN AND ASKED ABOUT.** The two lines named and read on the fifteenth of January: a line of places kept by more than one community for longer than any book in that office goes back, and a record of a chain of vessels kept by nine communities with a date against each and a place against each. **THE BARE FACT OF THE NINE WAS ALREADY IN THAT BOOK AND IS NOT NEW IN THIS VOLUME, AND THE CHAPTER'S WORK WAS THAT SOMEBODY READS THE LINE AND ASKS WHAT THE NINE ARE, AND THE ANSWER IS THAT THIS YARD DOES NOT KNOW, HAS NEVER BEEN TO ANY OF THEM, HAS WRITTEN TO NONE OF THEM AND HAS ASKED NONE OF THEM ANYTHING.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — A REFUSAL TO HOLD IS READ AS AN INTENTION TO KEEP, AND THE ONLY WAY TO BE READ CORRECTLY IS TO HAVE SOMEWHERE TO PUT IT THAT IS NOT A HOLD.** **The entry of the fourteenth of January stands and was not improved on and was not answered in these twenty days.** What is new beside it is that this yard spent six of its own days putting four pages of other people's on that bench and had nowhere to put the fourth of them except a bench under a pump and a weight, and a man who sells lime, and the sheet is now gone.
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE QUESTION THE FOUR PAGES OPENED, AND THE ONE THIS BATCH LEFT STANDING.** A record a man can check, or a record nobody can check. The copyist refused it and gave the nearest thing she has, which is that there is no figure for either. **The question left standing at the close of this batch is WHAT A COPY IS, and not what it is worth, and it is in the second column with a reason against the line.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE PRICE OF A CHECKABLE PAGE AND OF AN UNCHECKABLE ONE, PRICED A THIRD TIME, IN ANOTHER TRADE, ON A DIFFERENT QUESTION.** A copyist of fifty-eight: a record a man can check is worth what the man is who checks it; a record nobody can check is worth what the person who keeps it is worth; there is no figure for either; the making of a thing is her whole trade and she has never once been asked about the other half of it; and in thirty-one years she has met about nine people she would trust with a page and about four hundred she would not, and the nine are not better than the four hundred. **She was not told what a second column is, she did not ask, and one penny went into the box for a sheet of paper and nothing else.**
- **CARRIED, AND PAID — THE THREE COSTS OF MOVEMENT 1 AND THE FIVE COSTS OF MOVEMENT 2 WERE NOT PAID AGAIN AND WERE NOT IMPROVED ON.** No day was refused, no day offered was not taken, no share came out of a boat, no method went out in a street, no name came off a list, and the corner of a sheet and a half that went soft on the fourteenth of January is now in pieces.

1. **THE VOLUME'S CLIMAX. AND A LEAD ABOUT THE HOLDER'S OWN BROTHER CAME UP THE SAME WEEK, AND IT IS REAL AND IT IS CHECKABLE. THE HOLDER CHOSE THE LIVING ARCHIVE AND LET THE LEAD GO. THE COST OF THE ARCHIVE WAS NAMED IN THE FIRST COLUMN ON THE MONDAY NIGHT AT ABOUT ELEVEN O'CLOCK, BEFORE THE DAY AND NOT AFTER IT, AND THE HOLDER GOT ON A CART AT TEN O'CLOCK ON THE TUESDAY MORNING AND WENT UP THAT COAST ROAD. THE MAN WHO BROUGHT THE LEAD WENT FOUR DAYS DOWN THAT COAST ON THE FRIDAY IN HIS OWN CART ON HIS OWN ACCOUNT AND DID NOT WAIT AND WAS NOT ASKED TO WAIT, AND NOBODY IN THAT SHED SAID A WORD, BECAUSE THE PRICE WAS NAMED AND NOT PAID. THE LEAD DOES NOT COME BACK. NOBODY IN THAT SHED IMPROVES ON THAT.** The wage of four marks did not go in on the Tuesday and the number of weeks fallen due is NINETEEN, all nineteen in the same breath, and the reason is the reason of the twenty-ninth of December and is not improved on. No confession, no fragment, no report talk, no second story, and the holder did not go over to the far bench.

PAID.** Chapter 250, Sunday the fourteenth of March, in a town four days up that coast. **A COPY OF THAT YARD'S PRINTED SHEET WENT TO THAT TOWN, ADDRESSED TO NO PERSON AND TO THE TOWN, AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-ONE OF THAT TOWN, WHO IS THE FOURTH OF THE FIVE HANDS AND WHO KEEPS A PAGE IN A DRAWER IN THAT TOWN, OPENED IT IN HER OWN KITCHEN, READ THE THIRTY-EIGHTH LINE, AND NAILED IT ON THE OUTSIDE OF THE MARKET WALL OF THAT TOWN AT ABOUT HALF PAST FOUR, ON A WALL THAT HAS NEVER HAD A PAPER ON IT, WITH FOUR NAILS AND NO OTHER PAPER OVER IT.** **This yard did not write to the man of fifty-eight who sells timber in that town and did not ask him and is not going to, and the reason she gave was on the thirty-eighth line and came in the ordinary post on the fifteenth.**

PAID INTO FOUR ANSWERS, IN CHAPTER 249.** **A page in a drawer in a place two days down that coast was read out in a kitchen on a Sunday to about nine people and put back and is not going to be read again; a page in a drawer in a place four days up that coast has been read by the person who keeps it and by nobody else and put back, and that person has told nobody what is on it; a page in a drawer in a chain of reed islands and floating markets has not been opened since it came, and the keeper wrote that down so that whoever reads it knows it was not opened and not that it was not looked at; and a page in a drawer in the next town down that coast has been copied out once in the keeper's own hand and the copy hung in a room people come into, with the page in the drawer. AND THE YARD IS NOT GOING TO WRITE TO THE ONE TOWN THAT HAS DONE THE THING THE YARD HAS SPENT FIVE VOLUMES SAYING A PAGE IS FOR, BECAUSE A PAGE THAT A TOWN PUTS ON A WALL BECAUSE A YARD TOLD IT TO IS A PAGE THE YARD IS HOLDING IN A DRAWER IN THAT TOWN.**

Fourpence at the post on the sixth of March. **The whole of what has gone out of this yard since the sixth of December past is now five hundred and twenty pence in six transactions at four counters, and the figures of *two shillings and three pence* and *four transactions* and *two counters* are withdrawn.**

## What the Volume 05 close inherits, in one place

**The volume's five movements are all written. The climax is paid, the resolution is paid, the new-volume question is asked a second time and not answered, the final chapter image is paid in full, and the volume's own closing position is paid. The volume's close is an AUDIT and not a writing phase: it reviews Chapters 201 to 250 and writes `reviews/volume-05/volume-05-close.md`, and it ADDS NO CHAPTER AND DOES NOT ROUND UP THE FINAL CHAPTER IMAGE, WHICH IS PAID IN CHAPTER 250.** It is owed eight things and nothing more, and two of the eight — item 3 and item 7 — are rulings this close owns rather than counts it can take from a state file.

1. **A WHOLE-VOLUME AUDIT** of Chapters 201 to 250 against `outline/volume-05.md` and its thirty-four locks, against `reviews/volume-04/volume-04-close.md`, which is the home of every ruling Volume 04 deferred, and against the six bible files. **THE REVIEWER MUST RE-DERIVE THE MONEY FROM THE CHAPTERS AND MAY NOT TAKE A FIGURE FROM A STATE FILE.** The chain is at `state/continuity.md` § *Batch 0005 as written* § 3 and closes in one line: **7,890 + (8 × 480) − 4 − 489 = 11,237.**

1. **THREAD 1, THE MARK, HAD THE WRONG DATE IN IT AND NOW HAS THE FOURTEENTH OF MAY**, which is nine weeks from the twelfth of March and is the only line in the fourth column. **The fouling ladder under it is now one ladder and it checks: four inches on the fifteenth, the seventeenth, the nineteenth and the twenty-third, the same four inches through eight days, and about a foot on the twenty-sixth, being eight inches in three days, and a foot and a half on the fourth of April on nobody's word. 2. **THREAD 2, THE THING THAT HAS TO BE CUT, LOST A REASON AND GAINED A CLEAN ONE.** The reason the yard gave for not naming the man at the far bench is no longer about a distance between two benches and is no longer about a family. **It is about a trade and a price, and it is a reason a later batch can be held to: a man asked on a mole whether he cuts answers it with a price, and this yard cannot pay one, and it is not going to ask a man of sixty-one what he will take. `workspace/volume-06/batch-0002/PROMPT.md` is corrected, and it had quoted the old clause as if it were lock L28a; L28a says a man of sixty-one may not be made a teacher and may not be made a door.**
3. **THREAD 4, THE FOUR COMMUNITIES, HAD THE WRONG COAST ON IT IN ONE PLACE.** The four people who keep a page in a drawer and who wrote and signed a limit are **four days down that coast**; the market wall with the thirty-eighth line on it is **four days up that coast**; the letter of the third of April went to a town **two days down that coast**. **The letter now says what was found on which of its three dates, and the three dates are kept apart, so a thread that used to read as one merged finding now reads as three findings and one of them is a thing a man can go and look at.**
4. **THE STANDING FIGURES OF THE BATCH ARE UNCHANGED AND WERE NOT THE SUBJECT OF ANY FINDING:** twenty-three weeks fallen due, a bag of sixty-five marks and threepence and the short of the wage of four marks at nine thousand seven hundred and sixty-three pence; a hundred and sixty-eight pence a day for the boat; five rota days and thirty-four charges walked on none; two wipes and two more to come; the far bench on three days of the twenty; and the fourth leaf ruled on the twenty-seventh of March and on no wall.
5. **AND ONE FIGURE IN THIS FILE WAS WRONG AND WAS NOT IN THE REVIEW:** the far-bench entry listed the three days out of order, being the nineteenth, the twenty-sixth and the twenty-first, and the order is now the nineteenth, the twenty-first and the twenty-sixth; and the holder's own presence was not recorded here and is now recorded, being fifteen days in that harbor and five on that road.

5. **THE CUT AS A THING MADE ABOVE THE WATER, AND THE THREE TURNS ON THE WATER SIDE, AND THE SERVING HALF A TURN OUT OF TRUE.** The batch's own method turned on itself: the yard's cut is the mark's fault, deliberately, because a shackle of this yard's own making with three turns on the water side would be two and two for a man with a spanner. **The fault in the serving is entered in the fourth column and not the first, because a thing which is not is not a thing a man did, and that is the whole of the volume's argument in one line of a bench.**
6. **THE FIGURE THE BAG IS SHORT OF THE WAGE OF FOUR MARKS HAS CEASED TO EXIST AND NOBODY SAID ANYTHING ABOUT IT.** It will not come back while the bag is above six hundred and forty pence, and the wage column is at a hundred and four marks, and the two facts do not speak to each other.
7. **THE FORM FOR UNSETTLED MATERIAL, WHICH IS NOW ATTACHED TO AN ADDRESS.** A form that has never been served, that nobody in this country knows the effect of, and that is served by being left at an address on a day, and this yard made itself an address in the ordinary post on the third of April for a good reason. **This is Movement 3 and its instrument is the delay and it is legal, and the price of serving it on a person is that person's afternoon and their fear and neither of those belongs to this yard.**
8. **THE DESCENT WAS AT FORTY FATHOOMS AND NOT AT SEVENTY, AND THE SEVENTY IS FOUR HUNDRED MILES WEST AND IS PAID IN MOVEMENTS 4 AND 5 AND NOT HERE.**

## Volume 06, Batch 0003 (Chapters 271–280), Movement 3 — as written, 28 September 2026

**NO CARD FILE EXISTS FOR THIS BATCH AND NONE WAS INVENTED. The volume's outline is the plan and the four state files are the plan, and where a state file and a chapter differ the chapter is right about what happened. The one rule of `outline/volume-06.md` lock L1 item 5 that this batch departs from is the same one Batch 0002 departed from, and it is recorded at `state/continuity.md` § *Batch 0003 as written*, item 1, and is not repeated here in a second place.**

### Threads carried from Batch 0002, and where each of them moved

1. **THE VOLUME'S QUESTION, WHETHER THE FLEET WAS SCUTTLED OR WHETHER IT WENT DOWN. NOT ANSWED, AND NOT ADVANCED.** The turn of Batch 0002 — answerable, and this party is the wrong party for it — stands. **The batch's ten days are spent on the other half of that sentence: a party that is the wrong party for a question is still a party, and this one is a keeper, and a house is a keeper.** Nothing at seventy fathoms was touched, measured, named or asked about, and no chapter of these ten says who wanted anything.
2. **THE PLATE IN ELEVEN FEET AND THE NOTE AGAINST IT. CARRIED OPEN FOR A THIRD VOLUME.** Not reached, not measured, not touched, not asked about on any of the ten days. **A chapter of this batch puts the plate in a list of what is not going anywhere near a room and gives the sentence of Volume 05 as the reason, and does not improve on it.**
3. **THE CHAIN OF CUSTODY. NOT AGED AND NOT WRITTEN TO.** Five pages in five drawers in five towns in five hands, made on the sixth of March. **This batch took the four lines of the sixth of March and read them out in full and found what they are about, and that finding is the batch's whole turn, and it was made out of a sheet this yard already had and nobody was asked.** This yard did not look in any of the four drawers it cannot look in, did not try, and wrote to nobody. **The new thing in this batch is not a sixth drawer; it is a form in a coat, and a post box on a corner, and a five-page chain that has just been found to be about a record and not about a house, which is the one thing in this book that does not survive the form.**
4. **THE FOUR COMMUNITIES THAT READ THIS YARD'S COPY. UNTOUCHED, AND ONE OF THEM IS NOW IN THIS BATCH'S OWN ACCOUNT AS A CONSEQUENCE.** **A daughter of nineteen in a town two days down that coast read a page of that yard's own printed sheet out in a kitchen in the autumn to about nine people, and has not read one out since and is not going to; and a form of an office that yard does not belong to is on her father's step; and the yard's own thirty-eighth line is the reason the girl can read and the yard did not ask her to and cannot undo it.** The two are entered as two and are not made into one. **The town four days up that coast, which put a page on a wall, was not written to, and the town four days down that coast, where four people keep a page in a drawer, was not written to, and the reason is the same reason it has always been.**
5. **THE DELAYED NOTE AT ELEVEN AND TWO. UNTOUCHED.** Nothing entered, nothing measured, no occasion, no figure written down again, and the answer inside it not approached.
6. **THE MAN WHO WENT UP A COAST ROAD ON THE SECOND OF MARCH. IN THIS HARBOR ON ALL TEN OF THIS BATCH'S DAYS AND UP NO ROAD ON ANY OF THEM, AND HE LOST A MORNING TO THE BODY ON THE TWENTIETH AND SAID ONE SENTENCE ABOUT IT AND NOBODY ASKED HIM A SECOND.** He lost an argument with his own undertaking of the fourteenth and broke it out loud on the fifteenth with a reason; he lost the outer marks on the nineteenth because a bar of four hundred yards is a line this party has told the coast it is keeping to by not going near; he said the turn twice, on the seventeenth and the twenty-fourth, and did not improve on it either time.
7. **THE THREE FIGURES THAT MUST NOT BE SWAPPED. NOT STATED IN THIS BATCH AND NOT ADVANCED.** Nine communities, six centuries, three hundred years of an office: not in any of the ten chapters in any order and not on a page of that yard's book.
8. **THE FOUR NAMES, THE FOUR HOLDS AND THE FOUR UNREACHED THINGS. ALL FOUR STILL UNREACHED.** The man of Ashtide's three marks, unasked about and unsent to. The bellwright's eight marks and a day of a boat, and the lead plug, and the undertaking of the second of July, none of them touched, and the bellwright was not asked anything. The five bells and the four people of that coast and their limit, **which the holder did not ask to have lifted once in these ten days, and the fact that this batch found a made floor at forty fathoms with a numbering at the end of every course is still not a reason to ask them and was not used as one.** The custody room and the three items and the live question no paper answers. **And the forty marks twice, standing whole and first after food, neither reduced and neither paid — AND A WOMAN WHO STANDS TO THE FORTY MARKS STOOD IN THAT SHED ON SIX OF THESE TEN DAYS AND WAS ASKED FOR NOTHING AND HER FORTY MARKS WERE NOT MENTIONED ONCE.**

### Threads opened by Batch 0003

1. **THE FORM. A SHEET WITH A NAME AND AN ADDRESS ON IT, HEADED IN PRINT AS PARTICULARS OF MATERIAL HELD AS UNSETTLED, WITH FIVE RULED LINES, ONE FILLED IN, A FOOT THAT SAYS SERVED AND HAS NOTHING AFTER THE WORD, AND A SEAL LINE WITH HALVEN ROOK'S NAME ON IT.** It has been served once, by being put in the ordinary post at a box on a corner of a mole at half past four on Sunday the eighteenth of April at a penny, at the only address in that yard's book which is not that yard's. **NOBODY IN THIS COUNTRY KNOWS WHAT IT DOES WHEN IT IS, AND NOBODY HAS ANSWERED IT IN A ROOM, AND IT IS NOT ANSWERED IN THIS BATCH AND MAY NOT BE ANSWERED IN THIS VOLUME BY ANYBODY IN A ROOM.** Its own claim is that a person who keeps unsettled material in a house is a keeper of it, and **this volume has not once made that claim false, and this batch's own argument is built on it and is also guilty by it.**
2. **THE KEEPER IN A TOWN TWO DAYS DOWN THAT COAST: WEND BRACE, THIRTY, WHO CANNOT READ, A HAND HIRED BY THE DAY AT THREE MARKS, WITH A DAUGHTER OF NINETEEN, ILSE BRACE.** The sheet was on his step on the twentieth and he stood in his own doorway on the twenty-first for about ten minutes and did not pick it up, and by that was out of a day's work, and on the twenty-second his daughter read it to him and he had it read twice. **A sheet is on his table, there is nobody to ask, and the three marks are not going to be paid and the reason is entered.**
3. **THE DRAWER UNDER A BED IN THIS HARBOR.** A woman of about fifty-eight who has sold fish off that quay for thirty-one years has a sheet of paper with a seal on it in a drawer with her will and her marriage lines, given to her by a son in a city in the autumn, and a man who buys fish from her told her in February to ask a woman of no office who would know what a paper was. **Nothing has been served on her, nobody has said one word to her, and she is afraid, and this yard is not going to write to her.** **THE PRICE OF THE VOLUME'S OWN SOLUTION IS A DRAWER UNDER A BED IN THIS HARBOR AND NOT FOUR HUNDRED MILES WEST UNDER SEVENTY FATHOMS, AND THAT IS THE BATCH'S LAST POSITION.**
4. **THE CERTIFICATE OF METHOD AND THE STANDING OF A CERTIFICATE IN A MARKET.** A certificate in the reading of worked glass and its faults, issued in the ninth year of her time in that office, whose whole standing is that a person may repeat what she has said under that method where a thing is on a table. **Its standing in that market is spent and it is not withdrawn and cannot be, and there is no office in this country to take it from her because she is of no office, and the copy of her certificate is in a drawer in a town four days up that coast in somebody else's keeping whom this yard is not going to write to.** It buys nothing and it is not paid for and it is not going to be restored on any page of this volume.
5. **THE BURNING IS THE KEEPING.** A person who burns a paper with unsettled material on it has handled it, and a person who has handled it has kept it, and a person who has kept it is the thing the paper is about. Said out loud twice in these ten days, once in a shed by a woman of no office for two men who had not said it, and once in a fish market in about forty people's hearing by the same woman. **IT IS THE CLAIM OF THAT OFFICE, IT IS TRUE, AND IT IS THE ONLY SENTENCE IN THIS BATCH THAT BOTH SIDES OF IT AGREE ON, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOOK IS GOING TO IMPROVE ON IT.**
6. **A HOUSE IS A PLACE A PERSON CANNOT REFUSE ANYBODY ANYTHING ABOUT, AND A DRAWER IS A HOUSE, AND A YARD IS A HOUSE, AND THIS SHED IS A HOUSE, AND THIS YARD HAS BEEN STANDING BEHIND ONE SINCE THE SIXTH OF MARCH PAST AND HAD IT THE WRONG WAY ROUND.** This is the sentence Movement 4 is built on and it is entered in the fourth column on the twenty-fourth and in the first column in Calder Marr's words.
7. **THE FOUR LINES OF THE SIXTH OF MARCH PAST ARE ABOUT A *RECORD* AND ARE NOT ABOUT A *HOUSE*, AND A RECORD HAS NO ADDRESS AND A HOUSE HAS ONE, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE.** The volume's own answer of the sixth of March survives the form. **The four people who wrote them are four days down that coast and they were not asked for anything and the limit they wrote stands and this yard is not going to ask them to take it off.**
8. **THE BAR OF FOUR HUNDRED YARDS OFF THE OUTER MARKS IS NOT A FENCE AND THERE IS NO POST IN IT.** It is a line of about a mile and a half running north-north-west about four hundred yards beyond the outer marks, on which the water darkens and stands up in a low sea, and any man in a boat can see it and any man on a mole cannot, and it is the only instrument in that harbor that says the same thing twice. **NO PERSON, NO BOAT AND NO LEAD OF THAT YARD WENT INSIDE IT ON ANY DAY, IT WAS NOT NARROWED BY ANYTHING, AND IT WAS NOT ASKED TO BE.** The outer marks and that line are both checkable by anybody with a boat and a compass, and the yard has paid three hundred and fifty-two pence to be told that nothing on that ground has changed since a chart of about thirty years standing.
9. **A SHILLING WAS OFFERED FOR NINE FEET OF CHAIN AND WAS REFUSED, AND THE REASON GIVEN WAS THAT A NAIL IS A THING THAT CANNOT BE A SALE.** About nine people on a front street now know that this yard has a chain it is trying to get rid of, and a man of about fifty-five of that harbor has said out loud what that does to the next man who comes down that street with a thing off a wreck. **The chain is on a nail and the bar is in a drawer and neither can be sold and neither can be given away and nobody has asked whose either is.**
10. **THE THREE THINGS THIS BATCH PUT INTO THE WORLD THAT THIS YARD CANNOT GO AND LOOK AT.** The five pages of the sixth of March, the six lines of the fourth column, and a sheet in a post office. **The third of them is going to arrive on a step and not in a drawer, and the yard said that out loud in a shed on the nineteenth of April and entered that saying it is the whole of what saying it does.**
11. **AND THE THING THE BATCH CLOSES ON, WHICH IS A CONVERGENCE AND NOT A PLOT: A WORD SAID IN A FISH MARKET IN THIS HARBOR ON THE TWENTY-SECOND OF APRIL, AND A SHEET IN ABOUT SIXTY BOATS ON THIS COAST THAT SAYS WHERE EVERY OTHER COPY IS, AND IN ABOUT TWO MONTHS THOSE TWO THINGS ARE GOING TO MEET IN A PLACE WHERE NEITHER OF THEM IS THIS YARD.** Said out loud on the twenty-fourth in a shed and entered in the first column, and it is the batch's forward pull and it is not a rescue and it is nobody's doing.

Movement 3, its ten days, its costs and its turn are intact, and no thread is opened, closed or advanced by either pass.**

1. **THE WAGE LIST IS TWENTY-SIX AND NOT TWENTY-SEVEN.** The twenty-sixth week fell due on Tuesday the twentieth of April past with no envelope and the column did not move, and the twenty-seventh falls due on Tuesday the twenty-seventh of April next, which is the first wage Tuesday of Movement 4. **The column stands at twenty-six lines and one hundred and four marks and has not moved and is not moved by this.**

### Threads opened by Batch 0001

1. **THE NOTICE OF THE SEVENTEENTH OF MAY, EIGHT CLAUSES, AND A NAME AND A RANK ON THE LAST LINE.** **It is the volume's instrument and it is careful in every clause and it does not close the port; it makes a master's lawful passage depend on a declaration that must be lodged with an office whose season ended on the thirty-first of March with nothing issued.** A master who declares truly is not detained. A master who does not carry a declaration may be detained and held to the outer marks. The line runs from the mole-head to a can upon a stake at the outer marks. **It continues until a notice says that it does not, and no notice that says that it does not has been written in this batch, and none may be in this volume, and the resolution is that the blockade is broken ENOUGH and NOT LIFTED.** The whole text is at `state/continuity.md` § 5.1. **THE NAME IS *SOREN VEY*, CLOSED-SEA SQUADRON, AND IT IS A LINE.**
2. **THE OFFICE THE FIRST CLAUSE NAMES, AND THE CLERK IN IT.** **A harbor authority whose season ended on the thirty-first of March, whose clerk is a man of about sixty who has been a clerk there twenty-two years, who is owed his own quarter and has been for two months, who has no book into which a paper can be put, who has had no power to receive anything since the first of April, who DID NOT GIVE HIS NAME AND WAS NOT ASKED FOR IT, and who said the words *I do not know* out loud in a room with one man in it.** **HE IS UNNAMED AND HE STAYS UNNAMED, AND HE IS NOT AMBROSE SELL: Sell is the clerk of the CIRCUIT office, a different man in a different building, and locks L15 of Volumes 03 to 06 read that Ambrose Sell AND the harbor authority's clerk are the mouths of clauses. As first written this thread merged the two, and gave the harbor clerk nine years in one chapter and twenty-two in another; both are repaired on the page and the thread now carries twenty-two.** **This is the volume's second turn and it is found by a person and not by an office, and the chapter says that nobody may stand in a market and say the notice was drafted to be impossible, and that nobody may stand in a market and say it was not.** Both halves are held and neither is a concession. **AND THE DECLARATION'S FOURTH LINE IS OPEN AND IS THE NEXT MOVEMENT'S PROBLEM: a master who declares truly must say whether she carries material that is the subject of an unsettled claim, and a *yes* hands a person to an office and a *no* is a lie, and this book does not permit a lie in a form.**
3. **THE COPYIST'S COUNTER IN A ROOM OFF THE FISH MARKET, AND THE TWO HUNDRED AND ELEVEN.** **A sheet is a penny and forty sheets are a shilling and that figure has not moved in nine years, and a copyist of about fifty-nine has been in that room for twenty-two years and has made two hundred and eleven copies of ONE NINE-LINE SHEET ABOUT A CHAMBER OF A DROWNED CITY since the twenty-seventh of April past, and is not going to stop, and the reason is that a copyist who stops copying is a copyist who has admitted she copied something, and a trade can be put in a schedule and a confession cannot.** **This yard bought one of them on the twenty-seventh of April past for a penny, and the nine lines are the nine lines of the copy of a copy of a municipal sheet of a chamber of a drowned city that is in that yard's own drawer. THE NAVAL NOTICE OF THE SEVENTEENTH IS A SEPARATE SHEET AND HAS BEEN COPIED FOUR TIMES SINCE, THIS ONE BEING THE FOURTH, AND THE TWO SHEETS SHARE NOTHING BUT A COUNTER AND A PENNY, AND THE NOTICE IS A NAVAL INSTRUMENT AND IS **NOT** A PRODUCT OF THE LEAKED SHEET. NO CHAPTER AND NO STATE FILE MAY SAY THAT AN OFFICE FOUR HUNDRED MILES OFF LEARNED ENOUGH TO PUT EIGHT CLAUSES ON A MARKET WALL BECAUSE OF A MUNICIPAL SHEET OF A DROWNED CITY, OR ANY OTHER CAUSAL CHAIN THE CHAPTERS DELIBERATELY REFUSE: the page holds the question open on purpose, the notice is a naval instrument, and this yard has entered that it does not know who wrote either of two true sentences four lines apart and is not going to say nobody did.**

### The eight threads handed in from the Volume 07 Batch 0001 hand-over, and where each of them moved

1. **THE DECLARATION'S FOURTH LINE, AND THE FACT THAT A *YES* HANDS A PERSON TO AN OFFICE. PAID, IN FULL, IN CHAPTER 312.** A man of about forty-three of the second lay carried a form in his coat from Monday the twenty-fifth of May and read the fourth line off his own form out loud twice in a fish market in about nine people's hearing, being: *whether she carries material which is the subject of an unsettled claim*. A man of about fifty of the second lay, who had carried a declaration to the harbor authority on the eighteenth of May and been refused a lodging of it and gone out and come back with nothing happening, said out loud: **a yes is a handing over and a no is a lie** — twelve words, counted out loud by the woman of about fifty-eight with the end stall — and gave two reasons, and said he was going out on the Friday with the box empty and that **that is the absence of a plan and not a plan.** **NO PERSON OF THAT YARD DRAFTED, COPYED, WITNESSED, COUNTERSIGNED OR ADVISED ON ANY DECLARATION FOR ANY VESSEL ON ANY OF THE TEN DAYS, AND THE REFUSAL WAS GIVEN OUT LOUD IN A MARKET IN FIVE PARTS.** The thread is paid. What it opens, and what is not answered: nobody knows what a *yes* would in fact hand over, because there is no person in the office to receive it.
2. **THE OFFICE WITH NO SEASON, AND THE CLERK IN IT, AND THE WORDS *I DO NOT KNOW*. PAID A SECOND TIME, AND WORSE, IN CHAPTER 313.** Two men went into the office on the west basin on the twenty-seventh of May, separately, and neither was sent by anybody. **The clerk is unnamed and stays unnamed, is about sixty, has been a clerk twenty-two years, is owed a quarter by his own office since the first of April, and is not the clerk of the circuit office.** He gave **the same three things in the same order**, refused to unsay or improve on the four words of the eighteenth, and added **a fourth thing that is not one of the three: he is not going to hold the form put on his table**, because in about four years somebody will want to know where that sheet was on the twenty-seventh of May and there is one answer to that. **The words *I do not know* are not said a second time on any page.** He said out loud, unprompted, that he has been owed a quarter and has not mentioned it to a living soul, and that nothing has been taken off him. **He is not a villain and is not a hero and has not been thanked.** The form is still at a desk in Ternwatch and is properly made and two witnesses signed it.
3. **THE NOTICE'S CLAUSE FIVE AND THE CAN UPON A STAKE, WHICH IS NOT ON A CHART OF NINE YEARS AND WAS THERE IN MARCH. UNTOUCHED, AND IT IS NOT A ROUTE.** It is not on any page of these ten chapters except in the standing inventory of the close, which says it was not followed, not put on any chart, and not asked about, and which says the man of about thirty-one with the chart in a bag was not asked one question and is not a witness. **It is not the volume's midpoint, which is the Bramble Strait storm route, and no Volume 07 chapter may call the can a route, may put it on a chart, may follow it, or may say what it is for.**
4. **THE ANGER WITH NOWHERE TO GO, AND THE SENTENCE THAT FINISHES IT, WHICH WAS UNPAID. PAID, IN CHAPTER 311, AND THE NEW-VOLUME QUESTION ASKED, ONCE, IN CHAPTER 317.** Both halves of the volume's governing sentence are now on the page and neither was on any page of Batch 0001: the twenty-one-word sentence said out loud in a chandler's in about nine people's hearing, and *and a man who cannot be angry at it will be angry at something else by Friday*, said unnumbered beside it. **And the line that goes with it is on the page too, said once, at a mole head on the thirty-first of May, in sixty-three words, counted four times.** He is asked for a name and has not got one and is not going to go and look for one, and says this is the third thing and the correct number is three and not four. **NO CHAPTER OF VOLUME 07 MAY ANSWER THAT QUESTION. NO CHARACTER NAMED A BODY AND NO CHARACTER PROPOSED ONE, AND A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-EIGHTEEN WAS STOPPED ABOUT FOUR WORDS FROM FINISHING A PROPOSAL FOR ONE.**
5. **ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE ON THIS COAST WHO CANNOT READ THE NOTICE, AND THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY WHO CANNOT READ AT ALL, TWO DAYS DOWN THAT COAST, WHO IS A MAN OF THAT YARD IN ABOUT FORTY PEOPLE'S HEARING AND IS NOT ONE. CARRIED AND UNCHANGED, AND SAID AGAIN.** The count is repeated on the face of a chapter on the twenty-ninth of May by the man of about thirty-four who cannot tell what four lines of the notice mean, and it is in the close. **No person in that yard went and told one of those eleven people anything, no person is going to, and no chapter of this volume resolves it.** The man of about thirty was not written to on any of the ten days.

UNTOUCHED.** **This yard did not go back to that counter on any of the ten days.** The copyist of about fifty-nine was not visited, not asked, not thanked and not mentioned to anybody, and no figure of hers was entered in these ten days. **The two hundred and eleven are NOT copies of the notice of the seventeenth and may not be counted as such; the notice has been copied four times since, this yard's being the fourth, and the two sheets share nothing but a counter and a penny.** The woman with the cloth is not mentioned again in this volume.
7. **THE WARDROBE OF A BLOCKADE ON ONE HARBOR'S GROUND, ALL OF IT FIGURED. PAID ONCE AND CHANGED ONCE.** Eleven boats of the third lay were lying off on the twenty-fourth of May; **there were nine on the twenty-sixth, eight on the twenty-ninth and seven on the third of June, and not one of them passed the line and not one of them broke any rule of that harbor.** A candle is fourpence. A slip is three shillings a week. A boat's man is four marks a day. **A barrel of lamp oil is four hundred and fifty pence, being thirty-seven shillings and sixpence, and was three hundred and seventy-eight pence, being thirty-one shillings and sixpence, in February, and a mole-head light with its lens out since the seventh of May was going to be out in October on the February figure.** A sheet of paper is a penny and forty sheets a shilling and it did not move. A sack of flour, a bushel of salt, a fathom of rope, a fathom of canvas, a hundredweight of coal, a set of buntangs and a cask of tar **did not move**, and a small bottle of physic at fourteen pence with *none in this harbor* against it did not move, on purpose. **A man of about twenty-six with a hod of lime said out loud in a market that the man of about thirty-six is not to be trusted with anything, and the man he said it to did not answer him.**

CARRIED, AND TOUCHED ONCE BY SOMEBODY ELSE.** Elias Voke is not on the page of these ten days and may not be made a symbol. **A chandler said out loud in a market on the twenty-ninth that this man stood at his counter for a quarter of an hour on the twenty-eighth and bought no candle at fourpence, and that the chandler did not ask him what he had, and that this is what he has instead of a reason.** The clerk who took his letter and had no season is the same unnamed clerk of about sixty, and the fact that he has now said his own quarter out loud in that room is on the page.

### Threads opened by Batch 0002

1. **THE TWO PRIVATE HIRES INSIDE THE HARBOR LINE, AND WHAT A YARD THAT HAS REFUSED TO BE AN INSTRUMENT OF ANYBODY DISCOVERS IT COSTS.** Friday the twenty-eighth of May, one mark and eightpence, a boat of about thirty tons with a man in her for a day, hired by a boat's owner of about fifty-five for his own account and his own purpose, to get his own hook and chain out of about nine feet of mud off the west quay. Monday the thirty-first, the same figure, the same boat, hired by a man of about thirty-six of the third lay to shift about nine tons of salt off a lighter inside that harbor's own line. **Neither was salvage, a claim, a claim window, a charter or a way of getting past anything, and all five of those things were said out loud to every person in each boat before the painter went and not after, by the hirer and not by the yard.** This thread is the volume's own question about instrument and is not resolved.
2. **COBB TERRELL, ABOUT FORTY-ONE, OF THAT HARBOR'S OWN SECOND LAY, A HIRED HAND, AND THE FIRST PERSON IN THIS HARBOR WHOSE NAME THIS YARD HAS ENTERED AT A HIRER'S INSISTENCE SINCE THE SEVENTEENTH OF MAY.** He gave his name out loud, he was hurt at about half past three on the Friday in about nine feet of water off the west quay by a broken stud on the end of a chain, he did not go in the water, he went to a bonesetter on the Saturday on a crutch on his own and paid nothing, and **he said the figure out loud twice in public of his own accord, being two marks, seven shillings and fourpence, being four hundred and eight pence, and that he is not to put weight on the left foot for ten days and is not to be on the water for fourteen.** This yard paid the figure out of its own book on the second of June. **He is named, he is a person of no office, he is not a witness, and no later chapter may make him a symbol of anything.**
3. **THE ASKING, ON THE THIRTIETH OF MAY, AND THE SECOND OCCASION OF A SENTENCE.** A man in a blue coat, about fifty, with a book, a working man of a closed-sea squadron and not an officer and not named, asked a man in a boat this yard had paid one question. **The holder of that writ gave the standing reason out loud before the man answered, and the answer was *I am not going to tell you what you should have said*, and the reason it was said a second time was given out loud on a mole in nine people's hearing rather than kept.** This is the rule of the first of May past in operation, and it is not to be improved on and is not to be given a third occasion without the reason being given again on the page.
4. **THE CHANDLER'S COUNTER, SHUT TO ONE MAN, AND THE COUNT.** A sentence of fifteen words with a trade in the first four of them, said in a market in about nine people's hearing on the twenty-ninth of May by a man of about thirty-six of the third lay who carried it four days and put those four words on the front of it at his own table on purpose on the Thursday night. The chandler did not ask and was not asked. **The cost to the man who said it is that he buys no candles at that counter, at fourpence, about sixty of them before the end of June, being four shillings, and that the chandler's wife said out loud that it is a price of fourpence and it is going to be a price of nought.** This yard sent nobody, asked nobody, told nobody and bought no candle, and says so out loud, and the fourth-column line for the twenty-ninth is that **a harbor has been arranged wrongly in eight days by a man naming a trade in a market in about nine people's hearing, and that not one boat moved and not one sheet of paper moved and no person in that market was asked anything by anybody.**
5. **THE SECOND HAND ON A DRAWER, AND THE TENTH PLACE IN A CUPBOARD OF PLACES.** Mara Venn asked, once, on the twenty-eighth, who is the second hand on the round of glass. **It was not answered and is not going to be answered in this volume, because a second hand is a second address in this country and that was refused on the ninth of April past and again on the twentieth of May past and was not agreed to on the twenty-eighth either.** This yard has now named ten places and has a handle on the inside of none of them. **The concealment is spent and is not told again for nothing and is not told at all in this batch.**
6. **A TUESDAY ON WHICH NOTHING HAPPENED, TWICE.** The eighteenth of May, in Chapter 304 of this volume, and the second of June, when the man of about thirty-six went out with nine tons of salt in his boat and was not asked for a declaration and was not stopped and was not followed and came back in on the third. **The ship's hand entered on the third of June that there are now two, that the first is in the book and the second is going in that night, that neither can be checked by anybody, and that she does not have a column for what it costs to be a Tuesday.**

### The eight threads handed in from the Volume 07 close, and where each of them moved

1. **THE SHEET OF FORTY LINES AND ITS FIVE PLACES.** **PAID, AND THE PLACES ARE NOW FIXED AND COUNTED IN THE OPEN.** The five places are a drawer in that shed, a room off the fish market, a boat in that harbor, a coal locker in a town four days up that coast, and a man's own lockers in that town. The sheet has a name and an hour on all forty and a price and a payer on thirty-seven and the wrong figure standing beside its own correction. **THE FOUR COPIES ARE FOUR LEAVES IN FOUR HANDS AND EACH ONE OF THEM WAS REFUSED BY ITS OWN HOLDER IN ITS OWN WORDS.** The route, the two prices, the two foot of difference, the mark's closed use at four figures, the second seam's season of nine marks and the mark four hundred yards off it at nine marks, none paid, all stand untouched. **NOTHING OF THE SHEET MOVED AND THE STORM-READER STAGE WAS NOT RE-TAKEN.**
2. **A WRECK ON THE FOUL, SIX MEN WITH NO BOAT, AND A PUBLIC SENTENCE THAT WAS NOT COMFORTED.** **PAID IN PART AND IT IS THE WORST PART OF THE BATCH.** A man of about fifty-one put the six of them, the nineteenth of June, twenty minutes to six, off the south end, and a boat, and no figure, on the back of a reeve's office docket on the dry stone of that mole's crown on the eighth of July, in his own hand, with two spellings nobody in that shed corrected and no copy kept. He is one of the six. **THE OTHER FOUR OF THE SIX HAD NOTHING AND WERE NOT TOLD THERE WAS ANYTHING. ONE OF THE SIX TOOK A DAY'S WAGE ON THE TWELFTH, BEING ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-EIGHT PENCE, AND THE SECOND OF THE SIX WORKED THAT SAME DAY FOR NOTHING, WAS TOLD THE TERMS BEFORE HE WENT OUT, SAID HE KNEW THEM, AND LOST THE TOP OF TWO FINGERS OF HIS LEFT HAND OFF AN ADRIFT BUOY'S SHACKLE AT HALF PAST TWO IN THE AFTERNOON AND PAID FIVE SHILLINGS AND SIXPENCE OUT OF HIS OWN HAND FOR IT AND IS OFF THE WATER NINE DAYS.** There is still no boat, still no replacement, still no instrument and still no proposal, and the sentence of the twenty-third of June stands and the acceptance of the twenty-ninth of June stands and neither was re-said.
3. **THE NOTICE, ITS CLAUSES, AND THE MECHANISM BUILT ON THEM.** **PAID, AND THE SIXTH CLAUSE IS NAMED AS THE MECHANISM AND IS NOT IMPROVED.** It has been on its wall in a different street for fifty-eight days as at the fourteenth of July. The fifth clause is a breach and the sixth is free, and a small steam tender of about ninety tons lay at the outer water for five days without declaring anything and without hailing anybody, **and the sixth clause is the reason that harbor is open and was written by an office that did not write it for that harbor.** The man of about fifty's second paper went onto the table on the fifth of July with the fourth box not filled, and the man already at that table is a man off the west quay and is not this man, and neither spoke, and the clerk of about sixty wrote both names in one register and neither looked at the other's line. **The clerk was not asked one question on any of the ten days and no line of any column stands against him.**
4. **THE GOVERNING SENTENCE AND THE CAPTAIN, AND THE NEW-VOLUME QUESTION ASKED ONCE AND NOT ANSWERED.** **PAID AND NOT RESOLVED, AS IT MUST BE.** **ADMIRAL SOREN VEY, FIFTY-TWO, OF THE CLOSED-SEA SQUADRON, IS NAMED ON THE FACE OF ONE INSTRUMENT IN MOVEMENT 1 AND ON NO OTHER PAPER IN THAT HARBOR, PRINTED SMALL AT THE FOOT OF IT, AND NO MEANING WAS READ INTO IT, AND HE IS IN NO ROOM, ON NO MOLE AND IN NO MARKET.** A working man of nineteen with a boat's hook and a young man of about twenty-three with a telescope are the faces of that squadron on the face of this batch, and a packet man of about thirty-four said nine words about what a tender does. **THE NEW-VOLUME QUESTION WAS NOT ASKED AGAIN ON ANY OF THE TEN DAYS AND IS NOT ASKED AT THE MOLE HEAD, AND NO BODY AND NO COMMITTEE AND NO ASSEMBLY AND NO FLEET AND NO WING AND NO GUARD WAS PROPOSED BY ANYBODY IN THAT HARBOR, AND THE NAMING OF THEM IS A NAMING OF A KIND.**
5. **ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE WHO CANNOT READ THE NOTICE, AND THE MAN OF THIRTY TWO DAYS DOWN THE COAST.** **PAID AND IT IS THE SPINE OF THE BATCH.** **THE ELEVENTH OF THE ELEVEN IS NAMED: A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-ONE WITH A STALL TWO IN FROM THE END AND A PAPER IN A BOX ELEVEN DAYS OLD THAT SHE DID NOT OPEN. Four sentences were read to her in a market in about eleven people's hearing and then nothing else, because nobody in that yard is to tell any of them anything, and the rule is the yard's own and was made in May after a boy of seventeen carried a word up a hill in front of a woman. SHE SAID IT WAS IN HER BOX AND SHE IS NOT TAKING IT TO ANYBODY TO BE GOT RID OF. THE SIXTH OF THE ELEVEN IS A MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-FOUR ON A HARD WHOSE REFUSAL IS THE FIRST LINE ON THE SHEET OF FORTY LINES, AND HE CAME AND SAID HE HAD ONLY GOT THE ONE NO. THE SECOND OF THE SIX MEN WITH NO BOAT IS ALSO ONE OF THE ELEVEN AND WAS TOLD SO AT THE DOOR OF A SHIPWRIGHT'S HOUSE BY THE SHIPWRIGHT'S WIFE, AND HE WAS NOT ADDED TO THE COUNT BECAUSE NOBODY ASKED.** The man of about thirty, two days down that coast, was not sent for and was not written to and does not know there is an instrument. **THE SENTENCE THIS OWES, AND IT IS ON THE FACE OF CHAPTER 352: an instrument that wants eleven people to sign one sentence cannot be answered honestly by anybody in that harbor, because one of the eleven cannot read it and nobody is permitted to read it to her, and a signature obtained from a person who does not know what she is signing is worse than no signature because it can be printed.**
6. **THE PRICE LIST, CHANGED ONCE AND NOT DOWNWARD.** **PAID AND HELD AGAINST EVERYTHING.** A barrel of lamp oil at four hundred and fifty pence, being thirty-seven shillings and sixpence, quoted the first of June, February's three hundred and seventy-eight pence, being thirty-one shillings and sixpence, still visible above it with both dates on the board, and it did not move and the mole-head light is not lit and its lens has been out since the seventh of May. **THE FIGURE DID NOT MOVE ON THE TENTH OF JULY WITH A TENDER OF ABOUT NINETY TONS STANDING AT THE OUTER WATER FOR FIVE DAYS, AND THE BAG IN THAT HARBOR'S OWN YARD GREW FROM NOTHING TO TWO HUNDRED AND FOUR PENCE OVER THE SAME TEN DAYS AND THE OIL DID NOT COME DOWN.** Four boxes of physic and four tons of flour are not in this batch and are not repeated here. Physic at fourteen pence with *none in this harbor* stands. The harbor's poverty is worse on the fourteenth of July than on the fourteenth of May and the close says so on the face of Chapter 360.

### Author-level decisions taken in this batch

1. **THE FORM IS NEVER OBTAINED AND ITS SHAPE IS THE WHOLE OF THE EVIDENCE, AND THE EVIDENCE IS A BOARD AND A FAIR COPY.** No document changes hands on the water, the holder does not go close enough to either impression and does not ask, and there is no page of this series on which the form's whole text stands. Fixed at `state/continuity.md` § 4 item 1.
2. **THE SEVEN THOUSAND IS A FIGURE WITH NO NAME, NO UNIT, NO COLUMN HEAD AND NO EXPLANATION IN ANY MOUTH, AND IT IS NOT ENTERED AS A SUM.** The two grounds for that are on the face of Chapter 374: a figure not written out in pence and in marks and shillings and pence is not a sum of money to a shed that keeps a book, and the day a yard gives a piece of paper a name is the day it has an opinion about it. Also at § 4 item 2.
3. **THE COST IN FLOUR IS A TOW, A PAINTER, A LIGHTER ON THE GROUND AND WET FLOUR IN HER BOTTOM, AND HE CUTS HIS OWN LINE.** Fixed at § 6. The alternative considered and refused was that the cost be a boat or a crew, and it is not, and no man of that harbor lost a boat in this batch.
4. **THE TENDER MOVED FROM THE OUTER WATER TO THE HEAD OF THE LINE INSIDE IT ON THE MORNING OF THE TWENTY-SEVENTH, AND NOBODY WAS TOLD WHAT SHE IS FOR.** That is seventeen days at the outer water and eight inside the line and twenty-five days about that water in all, and the young man of about twenty-three is on her roof and is not an officer and was asked nothing and said nothing. Also at § 5.
5. **THE CROWN'S FUTURE CLAIM ABOUT INDEPENDENT SALVAGERS IS PAID FOR HERE, QUIETLY, BY A MUNICIPAL CLERK AND NOT BY ANYBODY ASKING FOR IT.** The man of about fifty writes the twenty-seventh of July into his own box in his own hand, and the yard asks him nothing and stops him from nothing, and the reason is on the face of Chapter 379. This is the batch's most important structural decision and it is not a plot invention: it is the municipal paper of Movement 2 coming back with a consequence.
6. **THE COPYIST'S ROOM IS THE PLACE WHERE THE WORD IS FOUND IN A FAIR HAND, AND SHE IS NOT ASKED AND DOES NOT BECOME A WITNESS.** Fixed at § 4 item 3.
7. **THE LEAF'S SECOND COLUMN AT THE HOUR OF THE LAST DAY'S READING IS FOUR HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SEVEN, AND THE PHASE PROMPT'S FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTEEN IS RULED AGAINST.** Also at § 1 and § 12 item 6. This is the third cistern-or-counter error in three consecutive hand-offs and the second of them to be in the second column.
8. **THE CONVOY IS EIGHT WORK BOATS AND A TENDER, NOT A MAN-OF-WAR, AND NOTHING IS FLYING AND NO GUN IS VISIBLE.** That is a deliberate narrowing, because the volume's antagonist is a policy and a form and not a fleet, and lock L22 forbids the word and the outline's § *Divergences* item 1 records that the chapters use the *squadron*.
9. **THE FOURTH COLUMN'S LINES ARE THE NINETY-SIXTH THROUGH THE HUNDRED AND FIFTH, ONE A DAY, NO DAY IN TWO OF THEM, AND THE HUNDRED AND FIFTH IS THE LAST LINE IN THAT BOOK.**
